findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seo_audit_page, check_robots_sitemap_llms_txt, request_full_audit · Private data: check_robots_sitemap_llms_txt, check_agent_readiness, draft_llms_txt, draft_robots_txt_for_ai_crawlers, request_full_audit · Public sink: request_full_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seo_audit_page, check_robots_sitemap_llms_txt, request_full_audit · Private data: check_robots_sitemap_llms_txt, check_agent_readiness, draft_llms_txt, draft_robots_txt_for_ai_crawlers, request_full_audit · Public sink: request_full_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
